entry.name: daemonUrl
entry.label: Base URL of the local sarvam-meter daemon, for example http://127.0.0.1:8787

entry.name: refreshSeconds
entry.label: How often the widget polls the daemon, in seconds

entry.name: compactMode
entry.label: Which value the compact representation shows: sarvam (Sarvam balance) or cliproxy (CLIProxyAPI quota)

entry.name: warnBelowPercent

entry.label: Show the per-API spend breakdown in the full representation
